notes.title: New Update: Build v0.5.4.4
notes.content:
Howdy Gearheads!
I have uploaded build v0.5.4.4 and made it available to Testers. The road to Early Access release continues. This update includes a new Custom Music Player. This allows you to play your own music while racing. I know that not everyone will want to listen to the OST so this made perfect sense.

Next Update will add Garage Customization.

Thank you for your continued support!

More Updates soon!
-Foamy

notes.title: Hover Muscle Update
notes.content:
Hover Muscle takes another step forward towards Early Access release. The latest update includes a lot of QOL features and Ghost Racing. I understand the game is not yet available to the general public but I also know that those folks that have wish-listed the game would probably like to hear it's moving forward.

The game is really coming along and the list of things to get done in order to be able to release into early access is getting shorter each day. I will be updating screenshots pretty soon since the overall visuals have improved. I look forward to being able to post more info, art and game play over the coming months.

Till next update!
-Foamy
NoLight Games
